# Amber Property Corner - Real Estate & Construction

> Amber Property Corner is a premier real estate agency and construction consultancy in Karachi, Pakistan, specializing in verified residential bungalows, commercial assets, plots, legal approvals (SBCA/KDA), turnkey house construction, and property valuation.

## Core Services
- Property Buying & Selling: Verified houses (80 to 1000 Gaz), plots, apartments, and commercial plazas in North Nazimabad, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Federal B Area, Scheme 33, and Buffer Zone.
- Legal Due Diligence & SBCA Approvals: Registry checks, Sanad verification, building layout map approvals, and demolition NOCs.
- Turnkey House Construction: Complete construction from foundation to finish, Grade-60 steel, and modern elevations.
- Room-by-Room Renovation: Modular kitchens, Italian tile bathrooms, and gypsum false ceilings.
- Seepage & Waterproofing: Permanent chemical waterproofing and plumbing line replacement.
